latest.title: Outward minimizing $p$-capacity, horizons, and Schwarzschild rigidity
latest.abstract: Let $(M^3,g)$ be a complete Riemannian manifold diffeomorphic to $\R^3\setminus\{0\}$, with nonnegative scalar curvature. Assume that a distinguished end is asymptotically flat, with ADM mass $m_+$. For each $p\in(1,3)$, define $c_{O,p}$ as the infimum of the Schwarzschild-normalized $p$-capacity over outward-minimizing finite-perimeter boundaries separating the two ends. We prove that $m_+\ge c_{O,p}$ whenever $A(g)>0$, where $A(g)$ is the infimum of the areas of boundaries separating the two ends. Equality at a single exponent produces a least-area horizon, forces its exterior to be the Schwarzschild exterior of mass $m_+$, and yields equality at every exponent. In the equality case, if the second end is also asymptotically flat, its mass satisfies $m_-\ge m_+$, with equality precisely for the two-sided spatial Schwarzschild manifold. We also show that a strict gap between $c_{O,p}$ and the unconstrained capacity infimum $c_{M,p}$ detects a horizon.
latest.workSummary: 在非负标量曲率的双端三维空间中，证明 ADM 质量控制外向极小 p 容量，并建立 Schwarzschild 等号刚性。
techniques: 外向极小有限周长边界
latest.breakthrough: 单一指数等号即可产生最小面积视界并强制外部 Schwarzschild 几何。
latest.limitations: 要求分离面积正下界及指定拓扑与渐近平坦端，不能省去视界存在所需条件。 已补读相关引言或主结果片段，尚未逐行验证完整证明。
